d:
Lithuania pulled off one of the most INCREDIBLE comebacks of the 2010 FIBA Basketball World Cup!
Spain looked completely in control, building an 15-POINT lead in the third quarter. But Lithuania refused to give up and completely turned the game around!
A HUGE fourth quarter comeback saw Lithuania erase the deficit, take the lead for the first time since the opening minutes, and hold on for a dramatic 76-73 victory over the reigning World Champions!
